event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 80 degrees, relative humidity 45 percent, barometer 30.13 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,067 feet, track temperature 119 degrees.

Herrera and Gadson have each won 5 times against the other in prior events and each has won 3 times against
the other in final rounds. 

Gadson with the starting line advantage, but Herrera chased him down for the win.  He wins his third Wally
this season and 31st of his career.
